propositions: The planning corpus size constant (113) drifts against live ticket state because corpus membership is re-derived at runtime from current ticket classifications rather than pinned commit identities.
Reclassifying historical tickets to/from bug type or adding new tickets that change prefix resolution causes the corpus count to diverge from the pinned constant.
The corpus should be pinned by commit SHA identity (frozenset of 113 exact SHAs) rather than by count, making the validation immune to tracker churn and ticket reclassification.
The check mode should iterate pinned SHAs directly and assert identity equality plus flagged-set exactness against ADJUDICATED_SUBSTANTIVE, rather than re-deriving membership from live state.
Per-row ticket labels should remain best-effort artifact metadata but never gate the check; only commit identity and flagged-set membership gate validation.
